svg.title: One Principal, Three Bounded Contractor Scopes
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-06-four-person-core-pod; chart type: org_architecture; title: One Principal, Three Bounded Contractor Scopes; subtitle: The Base pod has four people; the Scaled pod expands to six.; chapter number: 11; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Each stage represents one core person: 1 FT + 3 C. Conservative and Base retain this four-person structure; Scaled uses 2 FT + 4 C by adding one full-time execution lead and one contractor for buyer research. Contractor status depends on actual working conditions and applicable law.; caption: The principal owns mandates, negotiations, and commercial decisions. Automation handles matching suggestions, milestone alerts, and document completeness checks, never substantive verification or unattended movement of client funds.; stages: label: Principal and mandate owner; value: One full-time operator owns representation and commercial decisions.; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Qualify sellers, confirm the permitted brokerage scope, sign engagements, negotiate commercial terms, and resolve conflicts. Maintain the cash forecast and capacity plan. Scaled adds a full-time execution lead rather than silently overloading this seat.; label: Buyer and seller researcher; value: One contractor maintains evidence-backed prospect and buyer records.; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Maintain HubSpot records, Airtable matching criteria, ownership research, buyer capacity evidence, and suppression lists. The Base allocation is $36,000 annually for the defined scope. Scaled adds another research contractor to increase qualified coverage.; label: Document and diligence coordinator; value: One contractor keeps the evidence room complete and controlled.; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Maintain SharePoint permissions, document indexes, version history, request lists, and discrepancy logs. Escalate contradictory seller statements rather than editing them into consistency. The Base allocation is $36,000 annually for this service scope.; label: Transaction milestone coordinator; value: One contractor tracks dependencies through independent escrow settlement.; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Maintain deadlines, counsel requests, inspection dependencies, secured-party releases, and closing checklists. Prepare reconciliations without controlling client funds. The Base allocation is $36,000 annually; counsel and escrow providers remain external vendors.
